subject: Hosted pricing: input/output token quote & supported model list
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@stratamind.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model roster

Hi Hannah,

We're kicking off an evaluation of hosted inference providers for a chat + summarization feature at StrataMind. Before we schedule a call, could you send a short baseline for: 1) per-1M token pricing split by input vs output, and 2) which models in your hosted catalog are "certified" for production (and any model size / throughput notes).

For context: our initial POC would be ~5M tokens/month (50/50 input/output) with spikes up to ~10M. We care about latency for short chat sessions (avg 60-120 tokens output) and want to understand what discounts/commit options you offer. Also, can you confirm whether function-call streaming or tool-calling affects IO billing?

If you have a one-page rate sheet or a PDF, that would be perfect.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Product Lead, StrataMind
elena@stratamind.com

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena@stratamind.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model roster

Hi Elena — thanks for the context, this is a helpful anchor. High level below; attaching a short PDF rate sheet for the hosted API that shows IO splits and typical throughput profiles.

Baseline hosted (list prices, USD per 1M tokens):
- Small-family (rwd-small, opt for low-latency embeddings): input $0.30 / 1M, output $0.60 / 1M
- Mid-family (rwd-medium, balanced latency/cost): input $0.60 / 1M, output $1.20 / 1M
- Large-family (rwd-large / open-llama variants): input $1.20 / 1M, output $2.40 / 1M

Notes:
- IO billing: we bill input and output tokens separately. Function/tool calls are billed on tokens produced/consumed; streaming itself doesn't change IO math.
- Certified production models: rwd-small, rwd-medium, rwd-large (Redwood-verified), plus validated community models: meta-llama-2-13b-q4 and mosaic-13b-ggjt (availability depends on tenant). The attached sheet has specific latency SLOs and concurrency guidance.
- Volume/commit discounts: for a 12-month commit we can layer discounts starting at 10% for 25M+/month, 18% for 75M+, and custom tiers above that. For a 5M/month pilot we typically recommend a small committed pilot credit + short-term overage billing.

Next steps: if you want a pricing scenario tailored to your expected IO split and concurrency target, share a quick spreadsheet with month-by-month token forecast and I can run numbers. I can loop in Ben (cc'd) — he handles commercial packaging and discounts.

Attaching: Redwood_standard_io_ratecard_v2.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Thanks Hannah — helpful start. A couple quick clarifications: 1) Our expected POC split might skew 30/70 input/output once summarization kicks in; can you re-run the math for 5M and 10M monthly with that split? 2) Do the "certified" community models have the same IO rates as the Redwood-verified families, or are there premium charges? 3) We're also evaluating committed vs. month-to-month; if we do a 6-month pilot with a 5M/month minimum, what's the best path for applying a pilot discount?

Also open to a 30-minute call next week — Elena, Hannah, Ben + your Solutions engineer to walk latency targets.

Date: 2026-10-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model roster

Ryan — appreciate the follow-ups. Answers inline and a proposed pilot pricing path: 

1) 5M / month, 30/70 IO split (example math, mid-family pricing):
   - Input tokens (30%): 1.5M * $0.60 = $0.90
   - Output tokens (70%): 3.5M * $1.20 = $4.20
   - Total per month = $5.10 (per-1M basis applied to each side; you can multiply by the number of 1M blocks). For 5M tokens total that equates to ~$25.5/month list — the attached PDF shows per-1M increments to scale to 5M/10M.

2) Certified community models: they are billed at the same IO rate as the comparable Redwood family for parity, unless you opt for a managed-performance tier (in which case there is a modest premium). We'll highlight availability per-tenant in the SOW.

3) 6-month pilot option: we typically offer a pilot discount of 12% on list IO rates for pilots with a 5M/month minimum and sign-up of our standard SOW. For production commitments (12+ months) the scale discounts in my earlier note apply. If you'd like, Ben can prepare a term sheet and a one-page SOW with those pilot terms.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync next Tue/Wed — Marissa (solutions) will join to confirm latency/concurrency targets and validate model choice. Ben will draft the pilot commercial terms.

Attaching SOW_template_StrataMind.docx for your review.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
Hannah
